label: Formal Greetings
description: Polite openings, closings, and respectful phrases for strangers, work, and service situations.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite opening. 1. 'Здравствуйте' is the standard formal greeting. 2. 'Как вы поживаете?' is a respectful way to ask how someone is doing. 3. This is the right shape for unfamiliar or professional conversations.

Strategic focus: Introductions. 1. 'Добрый день' gives a formal daytime greeting. 2. 'Очень приятно' is the standard polite expression for meeting someone. 3. The whole line works well in work, school, and service settings.

Strategic focus: Respectful request. 1. 'Извините' softens the approach immediately. 2. 'Можно вас спросить?' asks permission in a polite way. 3. This is a very useful line for asking directions or help from a stranger.

Strategic focus: Formal thanks. 1. 'Благодарю вас' is a more formal thank-you than 'спасибо'. 2. 'За помощь' names the reason clearly. 3. This line is ideal for service, work, and respectful everyday exchanges.

Strategic focus: Formal closing. 1. 'До свидания' is the standard polite goodbye. 2. 'Всего доброго' adds a warm but still respectful finish. 3. This gives the deck a clean ending phrase for formal situations.
